snippet.title: Big Pixel Zombies [Flash Game]
snippet.description:
GAME AVAILABLE TO LICENSE - please email contact@bigpixelstudios.co.uk

Big Pixel Zombies - the latest zombie survival shoot 'em up from the developers who brought you the smash hit Big Pixel Racing.
http://www.bigpixelstudios.co.uk 

"The Outbreak has reached London! It's up to you and your dog to clear Piccadilly Circus of the zombies..."
